defects: Nonneg hypothesis quantifies over Ici N (x ≥ N, including the endpoint) instead of gold's Ioi N (x > N); mathematically equivalent here only because combined with the antitone hypothesis (f(N) ≥ f(t) ≥ 0 for any t > N), but not a literal restatement

Integrability hypothesis is phrased as Integrable f (volume.restrict (Ici N)) rather than gold's IntegrableOn f (Ioi N); equivalent since {N} is volume-null so the restricted measures coincide, but not syntactically the same domain
